mines.mine_notes: Underground gold mine, Bergama/İzmir (Turkey's first modern gold mine, operating since 2001). Company strategy uses centralized processing: ore from surrounding deposits processed at Ovacık. Per-mine production and grade not disclosed; plant-type disclosure only.

Underground gold mine near Ovacık/İzmir; ore trucked to Ovacık central plant (similar model to Küçükdere). Per-mine production not disclosed. Çukuralan crushing-screening plant EIA approved; EIA cancellation lawsuit filed by İzmir Metropolitan Municipality (ongoing, no final decision).
Open pit gold mine, Eskişehir (operating since March 2011). Own processing plant (third process plant). Per-mine production and grade not disclosed.
Underground mine, Gümüşhane. Underground mining operations discontinued (per FY2025 report).
Open pit mine, Kayseri. Open pit mining operations discontinued (per FY2025 report).
Feasibility-stage project near Ağrı (northeast Türkiye). Metallurgical studies largely completed; basic/detailed engineering completed; environmental tests ongoing.
Open pit gold-silver project, Çanakkale (added to reserves end-2020). EIA positive decision; Eskişehir Metropolitan Municipality filed lawsuit to cancel EIA (ongoing). Exploration continuing.
Project added to reserves end-2023; pre-feasibility completed.

notes: Company renamed from Koza Altın İşletmeleri A.Ş. (ticker KOZAL) to Türk Altın İşletmeleri A.Ş. (ticker TRALT) on 6 Nov 2025. Treasury shares transferred to Türkiye Wealth Fund (Aug 2024). FY2025 (1 Jan–31 Dec): 118,356 oz Au + 54,567 oz Ag produced; plant-type split: tank leach 111,500 oz Au @ 2.92 g/t + 54,500 oz Ag @ 2.60 g/t; heap leach 6,800 oz Au @ 0.83 g/t. Per-mine production/grade NOT disclosed (only by plant type). Unit cash costs US$2,334/oz (2024: $2,078); average realised gold price US$3,442/oz (2024: $2,405). Revenue TL16,935.2M (+48%); net profit TL4,104.3M. Reserves/resources (UMREK, effective 31 Dec 2024, audited): measured+indicated 3.662 Moz Au, inferred 5.404 Moz Au, P&P reserves 2.551 Moz Au — per-mine tables are images in the PDF and not extractable. 113 operating + 94 exploration licences; 2,122 employees.
